Since i updated and bundled all of my farm buildings together into [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34624]Bog's Witchy Farm Buildings[/url], it was time to move my ghostly haunted animals and their products into their own mod! ﻿Please make sure to have Content Patcher downloaded! That will automatically replace the vanilla animals and products with mine. 

I will be turning the existing Haunted Coops & Haunted Barn Animals mods into the AT versions of this mod in the coming week.

I hope you all are surviving this heat wave!

<3
